notes.title: Militia 2 is Live on Steam!
notes.content:
Militia is back with more bite-sized strategy that evolves to match your skill! Beat back hordes of ruffians that challenge you in Beam and Push World!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070510/Militia_2/

-All of the original Militia are back, plus two new worlds of Militia and enemies.
-In Push World, you'll cleverly reposition allies and enemies and dunk them into the water with a satisfying splash.
-Beam World has players reflecting magical beams with various interesting effects to help and hinder friend and foe alike.
-Weekly challenge mode with leaderboards.
-Many more units have 'refresh' abilities, but you are limited to one per turn
-New, more combo-riffic Militia recapture ability

notes.title: Added Keyboard/Controller Support! 50% Off!
notes.content:
Patch 1.12 is live!

-Added keyboard controls (Arrows/WASD + Z,X or Enter/Backspace)

1) Monthly leaderboard reset/hall of past leaderboard winners
2) Daily challenge levels
3) "Puzzle" maps
4) "Timed" mode rank ladder

notes.title: Axes and Acres Steam Page is Live
notes.content:
Hey Militia fans, the Steam page for BrainGoodGames' next game, Axes and Acres is up here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/448910. Check it out and let us know what you think.

In Axes and Acres, you are the lord of a small (but growing) farming village during the middle ages. Like Militia, you will use your ingenuity and cleverness to overcome the tough (but fair) tactical challenges provided by the single-player ladder.

It is a good deal more ambitious than Militia, featuring several brand new mechanics and ideas, and we think it will provide a huge amount of replayability and depth of strategy. Can't wait to release!
